source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Part 4 replaces some explicit stack diagnostics with narrower values. Immutable malformed attendee names move from debug to warn; malformed BYDAY and invalid responseMode move from error to warn. The BYDAY empty-array result and USER mode default remain. Falsy timezone ids still return null after their log is removed. The database delegate stops computing lastErrorString and a manual stack inside its catch, but still logs the caught object and returns null. These are local source changes, not a claim that the console never supplies stacks or that warning output was observed.
title: Calendar STACK removal changes selected severity and argument work as well as stack text
